title: Application of a collagen scaffold saturated with platelet -rich plasma in prevention of bisphosphonate -related osteonecrosis of the jaw in the rat animal model
authors: Razmara F, Bayat M, Shirian S, Shabankare G, Mohamadnia A, Mortazavi M, Alijani MR, Bahrami N. Heliyon. 2021 May;7(5):e06930. doi: 10.1016/j.heliyon.2021.e06930. * collacone®
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Application of a PRP-enriched collagen scaffold appeared to be a successful preventive treatment for BRONJ by effecting of the number of osteoblasts and osteoclasts, BMD, NBF, inflammation, and osteonecrosis” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
